title: 第49章 礼物：血债血偿！
novel_title: 唐逸孔诗岚大结局全文免费阅读
content_zh: 唐逸前世作为军人，他有自己的骄傲。前世除了父母，他谁都不跪。现在，是名义上的爹，不配让他跪。至于跪太子……他膝盖没那么软。“放肆，你是何人？见太子为何不跪？”太子侍读洪竹面色一冷，厉声呵斥。唐敬吓得脸都变了，赶紧抬手拉了拉唐逸的裤脚。唐逸却不为所动。太子抬头看了唐逸一眼，笑着抬手拦住洪竹：“哎，没事，今日是唐家大喜的日子，咱们是客，可别扰了主人家的兴致。”“都起来吧！孤和你们一样，都是来参加宴会的，不必多礼！”众人谢恩站了起来。太子走进天香楼，从唐逸的身边经过，却没看唐逸一眼。他径直走到唐敬的身边，笑着说道：“唐侍郎，恭喜了，你可教了一个好儿子，二十几岁的新科状元，纵观历史长河，也没有几个人。”“唐画很不错，才华横溢，能力出众，本宫很欣赏。”“但唐侍郎，也要注意其他孩子的教育问题，免得将来出去丢了唐家的脸。”唐敬一张脸顿时又青又紫又红，虽然太子没指名道姓，但谁不知道他说的就是唐逸。唐家的脸，都被这混账丢光了。周围的人也都戏谑看着唐逸，对唐逸指指点点。看着这一幕，最激动的莫过于颜霜玉了。她要让所有人都知道，柳如玉生的儿子，连给她儿子提鞋都不配。“哎，可惜小逸这孩子了。”颜霜玉看着唐逸，有些感伤：“这孩子很聪明，可惜柳姐姐过世后，这孩子一直对我有芥蒂。”“要是他能放下芥蒂，在我的悉心教导下，就算不能金榜题名，也绝对不会差，也不至于不懂规矩，冲撞了殿下。”二嫂林竹冷冷一笑，扶着颜霜玉道：“这怎么能怪母亲呢？母亲对他已经很好了。”“吃喝用的，都比大哥和唐浩他们还要好，是他自己不争气，怪谁呢！”听两人这么一说，众人看向唐逸的目光，都多少带有一点厌恶了。规矩没规矩，才学没才学，还敢冲撞当今太子，简直没一点点家教。难怪当初唐敬要将外室接回唐家，不将外室和优秀的孩子接回家，难道任由这样的废物败坏唐家名声？唐逸自然察觉到周围众人的异样目光，也知道太子在指桑骂槐，但他并没有在意。他今日来，只为妹妹讨一个公道，其他的和他有关系吗？“唐画，你很不错。”这时，太子已经走到唐画的身侧。他抬手拍了拍唐画的肩膀，道：“父皇让你进翰林院做修撰，是器重你，好好干，将来必定前途不可限量。”唐画睨了唐逸一眼，激动拱手：“是，臣必定鞠躬尽瘁，死而后已。”“哦？那你就是唐浩了？”太子目光落在唐浩身上。唐浩身体一颤，连忙激动道：“是的，殿下，没想到太子也知道小臣。”太子微微颔首，笑道：“自然是知道的，你唐家三兄弟，兄长进翰林院从政，弟弟从军在外征战，只有你则从商打理家族。”“你可是最重要的一环，无论兄长和弟弟，想要成功都离不开你的支持。”唐浩一听，顿时激动得心潮澎湃，哈哈，看吧，连太子都不得不承认我厉害，唐逸，你也配和我争？“多谢殿下夸奖，我一定更加努力的。”唐浩重重拱手，激动说道。唐敬听了太子的夸赞，心头满是欣慰，和颜霜玉生的三个儿子，就没有谁让他失望过。唯独唐逸。唐敬目光落在唐逸身上，心中不由充满失望。他母亲柳如玉当年号称京都第一才女，而他当年也是金榜题名进士出身，天时地利人和都让这混账给占了，怎么就扶不起他呢？你要是表现稍微好一点，获得太子殿下的几句夸赞，你将来的路也会好走不少。结果……你烂泥扶不上墙！“殿下，这是我四弟，唐逸……”这时，唐画故意将话题引到唐逸的身上。他们三兄弟都被太子夸赞了，现在他提起唐逸，所有人都只会认为他是在帮助唐逸，但他的目的，却是将唐逸彻底踩在脚下。太子看了唐逸一眼，笑道：“他很好，孤就不做点评了。”只是声音中略带嘲讽，他实在搞不清楚这么个废物，父皇为何会说他能动摇自己的地位。他，凭什么？！唐逸扫了唐敬和太子几人一眼，笑着摇了摇头，是很好。比起你们虚伪做派，我虽然不怎么样，但也的确比你们好多了。“殿下，里面请。”唐敬不想再让儿子丢人现眼，做了个请的手势，邀请太子入席。然而。唐浩又岂会错过这个当着太子的面，狠狠落唐逸面子的机会？他当即看向唐逸手中的卷轴，笑了起来：“唐逸，你这东西破破烂烂的，该不会是从垃圾堆中随便捡来的吧？”“今日可是我们大哥大喜的日子，谁的礼物不是价值连城？你别故意埋汰大哥。”“赶紧拿出去丢了，免得拿进去丢人现眼。”唐浩的声音不高，又刚好能让所有人听到。果然，太子停下脚步看了过来，唐敬脸色也是阴沉下来。唐逸手中的卷轴，果然破旧不堪，而且还有灰尘，给人的感觉就像是从挂在墙上很久了，让他随手从墙上扒下来送礼的。“唐逸，你又闹什么？滚出去。”唐敬有了不好的预感，指着大门冷声呵斥。冲撞太子，送破旧礼物，这混账东西今日就不是来参加庆功宴的，是来捣乱的？“唐侍郎不用那么着急赶人，我自己会走，当然，前提是，我得办完我的事。”唐逸抬手将手中的卷轴丢给唐浩，同时向他逼了过去：“你不是想知道是不是从垃圾堆里拿出来的吗？那就看看吧！”唐浩没想到唐逸会将卷轴丢过来，慌忙伸手接住。但只抓住卷轴的顶端，以至于卷轴当场打开了。残破的卷轴上只有四个猩红的大字。——血债血偿！看到这四个大字，满场瞬间寂静。
content_en: Tang Yi was a soldier in his previous life, and he had his own pride.In his previous life, he did not kneel to anyone except his parents.Now, he is the father in name only, and he is not worthy of being kneeled down.As for the kneeling prince...his knees are not that weak."Wangzhi, who are you? Why don't you kneel down when you see the prince?" Hong Zhu, the prince's attendant, looked cold and scolded him sternly.Tang Jing was so frightened that his face changed. He quickly raised his hand and pulled Tang Yi's trousers.Tang Yi was unmoved.The prince raised his head and glanced at Tang Yi, then smiled and raised his hand to stop Hong Zhu: "Hey, it's okay. Today is a happy day for the Tang family. We are guests, so don't disturb the host's mood." "Everyone, get up! I'm here to attend the banquet just like you, so there's no need to be polite!" Everyone stood up to thank him.The prince walked into Tianxiang Tower and passed by Tang Yi, but did not look at Tang Yi.He walked straight to Tang Jing and said with a smile: "Congratulations, Minister Tang. You have taught a good son. He is a new top scholar in his twenties. Throughout history, there are only a few people." "Tang Hua is very good, talented and capable.I appreciate it very much." "But Minister Tang, you must also pay attention to the education of other children, so as not to disgrace the Tang family in the future." Tang Jing's face suddenly turned green, purple and red. Although the prince did not name him, no one knew that he was talking about Tang Yi.The Tang family's face was completely disgraced by this bastard.People around him also looked at Tang Yi jokingly and pointed at Tang Yi.Looking at this scene, the most excited person was Yan Shuangyu.She wanted everyone to know that Liu Ruyu's son was not even worthy of carrying her son's shoes."Hey, it's a pity that Xiaoyi is the child." Yan Shuangyu looked at Tang Yi with some sadness: "This child is very smart, but it's a pity that after Sister Liu passed away, this child has always had a grudge against me." "If he can put aside his grudge, under my careful guidance, even if he can't be named on the gold list, he will definitely be good, and he won't not understand the rules and collide.Your Highness." Second sister-in-law Lin Zhu smiled coldly, supported Yan Shuangyu and said, "How can you blame mother?Mother is already very good to him." "The food and drinks are better than those of eldest brother and Tang Hao.Who is to blame for his failure!" After hearing what the two said, everyone looked at Tang Yi with a little disgust.There are no rules, no talent, no talent, and he dares to challenge the current prince. He has no tutor at all.No wonder Tang Jing wanted to take the outside wife back to the Tang family. If he didn't take the outside wife and his outstanding children home, would he allow such a waste to ruin the reputation of the Tang family?Tang Yi naturally noticed the strange looks from everyone around him, and also knew that the prince was criticizing Sang and Huai, but he didn't pay attention.He came here today only to seek justice for his sister. Does the rest have anything to do with him?"Tang Hua, you are very good." At this time, the prince had already walked to Tang Hua's side.He raised his hand and patted Tang Hua's shoulder and said: "My father asked you to enter the Hanlin Academy to be a editor because he values ​​you. If you work hard, your future will be limitless." Tang Hua glanced at Tang Yi and excitedly handed over his hands: "Yes, I will do my best until I die." "Oh? Then you are Tang Hao?" The prince's eyes fell on Tang Hao.Tang Hao's body trembled and he said excitedly: "Yes, Your Highness, I didn't expect that the prince also knew about the minister." The prince nodded slightly and said with a smile: "Of course I know. Of the three brothers of your Tang family, your elder brother entered the Hanlin Academy to engage in politics, your younger brother joined the army to fight overseas, and you are the only one engaged in business."You are the most important part of the family. Regardless of whether I want to succeed, I cannot do without your support."When Tang Hao heard this, his heart surged with excitement.Haha, look, even the prince has to admit that I am powerful. Tang Yi, are you worthy of competing with me?"Thank you for the compliment, Your Highness. I will definitely work harder." Tang Hao said excitedly as he heavily handed over his hands.Tang Jing was filled with joy after hearing the prince's praise. None of the three sons he had with Yan Shuangyu had ever let him down.Only Tang Yi.Tang Jing's eyes fell on Tang Yi, and his heart couldn't help but be filled with disappointment.His mother, Liu Ruyu, was known as the most talented woman in Kyoto back then, and he was also a Jinshi at that time. The right time, place, people and people were all taken over by this bastard, so why couldn't he help him?If you perform a little better and get a few words of praise from His Royal Highness, your future will be much easier.As a result...you can't hold up the wall with mud!"Your Highness, this is my fourth brother, Tang Yi..." At this time, Tang Hua deliberately brought the topic to Tang Yi.The three brothers were all praised by the prince. Now that he mentioned Tang Yi, everyone would only think that he was helping Tang Yi, but his purpose was to completely trample Tang Yi under his feet.The prince glanced at Tang Yi and said with a smile: "He is very good, so I won't comment." There was just a hint of ridicule in his voice. He really couldn't figure out why his father would say that such a waste could shake his position.Him, why?!Tang Yi glanced at Tang Jing and the prince, smiled and shook his head, "It's very good."Compared with your hypocrisy, although I am not very good, I am indeed much better than you."Your Highness, please come inside." Tang Jing didn't want to embarrass his son anymore, so he made an invitation gesture and invited the prince to the table.However.How could Tang Hao miss this opportunity to humiliate Tang Yi in front of the prince?He immediately looked at the scroll in Tang Yi's hand and laughed: "Tang Yi, this thing of yours is in tatters. Could it be that you picked it up from the garbage dump?" "Today is our eldest brother's happy day. Whose gift is not priceless? Don't deliberately bury your brother." "Take it out quickly and throw it away, so as not to be embarrassed by bringing it in." Tang Hao's voice was not high, but it was just enough for everyone to hear.Sure enough, the prince stopped and looked over, and Tang Jing's face darkened.The scroll in Tang Yi's hand was indeed shabby and dusty. It felt like it had been hanging on the wall for a long time and he had casually taken it off the wall as a gift."Tang Yi, what are you making a fuss about? Get out." Tang Jing had a bad feeling and pointed at the door and scolded him coldly.He bumped into the prince and gave shabby gifts. This bastard didn't come to attend the celebration banquet today, but to cause trouble?"Tang Shilang, don't be so anxious to chase people away. I will leave by myself. Of course, the premise is that I have to finish my work." Tang Yi raised his hand and threw the scroll in his hand to Tang Hao, and at the same time pressed towards him: "Don't you want to know if it was taken out of the garbage? Then have a look!" Tang Hao did not expect that Tang Yi would throw the scroll over and hurriedly reached out to catch it.But only the top of the scroll was grasped, so that the scroll opened on the spot.There were only four large scarlet scrolls on the broken scroll.
title_en: Chapter 49 Gift: Blood debt must be paid with blood!
